description: We're doing the storytelling challenge about two identical rovers-- Spirit and Opportunity. We are creating a minecraft simulation of Spirit and Opportunity's missions on Mars.
summary: For our project, we developed a Minecraft world focusing on the "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" challenge by telling the story of NASA's Spirit and Opportunity Mars rovers. Our project addresses the challenge by highlighting discoveries and abandoned human-made technology in deep space. This is important because it keep the history of space exploration relevant and reminds us of the significant contributions of the twin rovers, Spirit and Opportunity.
details:
We created a minecraft world to make information about the Opportunity and Spirit rovers' more accessible and engaging for younger audiences. It is essentially an in-game museum about the twin rovers and their missions in 2004.

This is a link to our Minecraft World (Education Edition): NASA Space Apps Challenge.mcworld
